name: @script_start_reason
doc: Returns the reason why the session started. The value remains constant throughout the session.

name: @agent_campaigns_info
doc: Returns the list of assigned campaigns of the agent.

fields.name: campaignName
fields.doc: Name of the campaign.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: If true, the agent has the campaign open.

fields.name: signOn
fields.doc: If true, the agent is logged in an extension and can handle calls for the campaign.

fields.name: ready
fields.doc: If true, the agent is ready in the campaign.

name: @audio_choose_option
doc: Returns the current menu index, DTMF option, and default TTS string in the context of the clause for each option play of the IVR audio action choose. The values are used to parametrize the TTS string, audio file, or audio resource expressions played for each menu option.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Index of the current menu option, starting at 1.

fields.name: dtmf
fields.doc: DTMF option of the current menu option.

fields.name: speech
fields.doc: Default TTS string of the current menu option.

name: @email_info
doc: Returns the state of the current email interaction.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state of the email interaction, as an enumeration of type EmailState.

fields.name: emailId
fields.doc: Numeric identifier of the email.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: For inbound sessions. Contents of the From field of the email.

fields.name: replyTo
fields.doc: For inbound sessions. Contents of the Reply To field of the email.

fields.name: subject
fields.doc: For inbound sessions. Contents of the Subject field of the email.

fields.name: acknowledgeGiven
fields.doc: For inbound sessions. True if the email gateway or a routing script acknowledged the email.

fields.name: defaultEmailTemplate
fields.doc: Identifier of the default email template configured for the campaign. Used when the campaign has the attribute **Default email template** defined.

fields.name: recovered
fields.doc: True if the email was recovered from a previous unfinished session.

fields.name: suspended
fields.doc: True if the email is suspended.

fields.name: sentTo
fields.doc: For outbound email sessions, email address to receive the email. Typically used as the contents of the To field of the email editor.

fields.name: fromAddressList
fields.doc: Array with the address of the possible senders of campaign emails, as configured for the campaign.

name: @error
doc: Returns the number of the last error.

name: @error_info
doc: Returns a specification of the last error that occurred in the script.

fields.name: reporting
fields.doc: For uAgent scripts, True if the script displays all errors to the agent in the Agent Portal errors area.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Type of the last error.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Code of the last error. The same as @error.

fields.name: sqlError
fields.doc: Contains 0 if the last SQL statement was successful. Otherwise, contains an error code that depends on the database engine. For this purpose, open and close cursor are SQL operations.

fields.name: noRowsReturned
fields.doc: True if the last SQL select or fetch cursor action did not return any row.

fields.name: message
fields.doc: The message of the last error.

name: @instant_messaging_info
doc: Returns the state of the current instant messaging interaction.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state of the instant messaging interaction.

fields.name: dnis
fields.doc: Number dialed by the client.

fields.name: callKey
fields.doc: Identifier of the current instant messaging interaction on the Altitude uCI Server database.

fields.name: externalData
fields.doc: External data received with the instant messaging interaction.

fields.name: enqueued
fields.doc: True if the instant messaging interaction is enqueued.

fields.name: recording
fields.doc: True if the instant messaging interaction is being recorded.

fields.name: primaryConnectionParties
fields.doc: List of participants of the instant messaging interaction.

fields.name: secondaryConnectionParties
fields.doc: List of participants of the extended instant messaging interaction.

name: @interaction_info
doc: Returns the types of media of the current activity.

fields.name: withPhoneInteraction
fields.doc: True if the script is handling a telephony interaction.

fields.name: withEmailInteraction
fields.doc: True if the script is handling an email interaction.

fields.name: withInstantMessagingInteraction
fields.doc: True if the script is handling an instant messaging interaction.

fields.name: withWorkflowInteraction
fields.doc: True if the script is handling a workflow task.

name: @login_info
doc: Returns login information on the Altitude uCI Server of the agent handling the current session.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Short name of the agent. For example, John.

fields.name: fullName
fields.doc: Full name of the agent. For example, John Smith.

fields.name: password
fields.doc: Password of the agent, in plain text.

fields.name: extension
fields.doc: Number of the agent extension, or empty if the agent does not have an extension.

fields.name: instanceAddress
fields.doc: Hostname and port of the Altitude uCI Server. For example, ccserver:1500.

fields.name: instanceName
fields.doc: Name of the Altitude uCI Server. For example, ContactCenter.

fields.name: site
fields.doc: Site of the extension of the agent.

fields.name: team
fields.doc: Team of the agent.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Type of uAgent that runs the script.

fields.name: switchAgentId
fields.doc: Identifier of the agent in the telephony switch.

fields.name: loginGroup
fields.doc: Login group where the agent is logged.

name: @phone_info
doc: Returns the state of the current telephony interaction.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state of the phone interaction.

fields.name: phone
fields.doc: Phone number of the contact. For an outbound call, it is the number of the remote phone, as stored on the Altitude uCI Server database. For an inbound call, it is the number signaled by the ANI service (automatic number identification), if known.

fields.name: dialedPhone
fields.doc: For an outbound call, the number dialed by the telephony gateway. Empty for inbound calls.

fields.name: acd
fields.doc: Number of the ACD (automatic call distribution) queue that delivered the call to the agent.

fields.name: dnis
fields.doc: For an inbound call, the number dialed, if known by the switch, as signaled by the DNIS (dialed number identification service).

fields.name: callKey
fields.doc: Identifier of the current phone call on the Altitude uCI Server database, used to identify recordings.

fields.name: trunk
fields.doc: Trunk used by the current phone call.

fields.name: ucid
fields.doc: The Avaya UCID used by the current phone call.

fields.name: externalData
fields.doc: External data received with the phone interaction.

fields.name: enqueued
fields.doc: True if the call is enqueued.

fields.name: recording
fields.doc: True if the call is being recorded.

fields.name: supervisedTransfer
fields.doc: If true, an agent transferred the call. If the agent transfers the call to a contact, the attribute is set to false.

fields.name: supervisionMode
fields.doc: Current type of supervision.

fields.name: primaryConnectionParties
fields.doc: List of participants on the phone call.

fields.name: secondaryConnectionParties
fields.doc: List of participants on the extended phone call.

name: @schedule_info
doc: Returns the schedule information of the contact loaded or of the current workflow task.

fields.name: agent
fields.doc: Short name of the agent that will call the contact or will handle the workflow task.

fields.name: moment
fields.doc: Date and time after which to place the call to the contact or to start the workflow task.

fields.name: ignoreDoNotCallList
fields.doc: If true, the number used to reach the contact is not checked against the do not call lists.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: Priority of the contact or of the workflow task, a number between -50 and 50. The default value is 0.

fields.name: outboundRule
fields.doc: Name of the outbound rule that defines when and how the Altitude uCI Server will call the contact.

fields.name: reschedulePhone
fields.doc: Reschedule phone number of the contact. Each contact can have a separate reschedule phone number.

fields.name: reschedulePhoneScheduleRule
fields.doc: Name of the schedule rule for the reschedule phone.

fields.name: manualScheduleTimeLimit
fields.doc: Latest time when the Altitude uCI Server can call the contact.

fields.name: skillProfile
fields.doc: Required skill profile to call the contact.

name: @script_info
doc: Returns static and dynamic attributes of the running script.

fields.name: majorVersion
fields.doc: Major version number of the script.

fields.name: minorVersion
fields.doc: Minor version number of the script.

fields.name: node
fields.doc: Name of the current node.

fields.name: windowId
fields.doc: Identifier of the window currently active.

fields.name: eventHandlingCount
fields.doc: Number of times an event has been handled.

fields.name: nameSpace
fields.doc: Namespace of the current node.

fields.name: fileName
fields.doc: File name of the script.

fields.name: filePath
fields.doc: Path name of the script, excluding the file name.

fields.name: scriptDocumentName
fields.doc: Identifier of the script document on the Altitude uCI Server, or identifier of the workflow definition, if the script is running for a workflow task. If the script is running in offline mode the value is -1.

fields.name: scriptDocumentRevision
fields.doc: Identifier of the version of the script document on the Altitude uCI Server, or identifier of the version of the workflow definition, if the script is running for a workflow task. If the script is running in offline mode the value is -1.

name: @script_session_info
doc: Returns the state and some statistics of the current script session.

fields.name: sessionId
fields.doc: Identifier of the script session.

fields.name: campaign
fields.doc: Short name of the campaign associated with the script.

fields.name: campaignId
fields.doc: Identifier of the campaign associated with the script.

fields.name: service
fields.doc: Name of the service associated with the script.

fields.name: serviceId
fields.doc: Identifier of the service associated with the script.

fields.name: contact
fields.doc: Identifier of the current loaded contact or -1 if no contact is loaded.

fields.name: contactPreviousState
fields.doc: Previous state of the contact.

fields.name: createdByWorkflow
fields.doc: True if the session is a workflow.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.doc: Name of the time zone associated with the contact.

fields.name: anonymous
fields.doc: Defines whether the script session is handling sensitive data. Anonymous script sessions do not display contact profile information.

fields.name: language
fields.doc: Name of the current default language of the script.

fields.name: directory
fields.doc: Name of the current directory associated with the script. When a contact is loaded, it is set to the directory of the contact. The action set current directory changes this field, except if a contact is loaded.

fields.name: contactProfileUniqueId
fields.doc: Identifier of the current contact profile associated with the script. On inbound sessions the user can set this field, and later change it with the load contact action, in which case it cannot be changed anymore. On outbound activities, the field is set at the start of the session, when the contact is loaded, and it can not be changed. On workflow activities, the field is set if it is specified in the workflow process and it changes if the load workflow contact profile action is called.

fields.name: transferredDirectory
fields.doc: Name of the directory transferred from another script by a blind transfer. The value is constant during each session. There is no directory extension record loaded when the blind transfer occurs. The field can be used to set the session current contact profile directory. The load contact with contact profile or the load workflow contact profile actions use the contents of this field to load the contact.

fields.name: transferredContactProfileUniqueId
fields.doc: Identifier of the contact profile transferred from another script by a blind transfer. The value is constant during each session. There is no contact profile loaded when the blind transfer occurs. The field can be used to set the session current contact profile. The load contact with contact profile or the load workflow contact profile actions can be used to load the contact profile and the associated contact, or just use the get contact profile action to query its attributes.

fields.name: availableDirectories
fields.doc: Array with the names of the directories that can be used by the campaign. The first element of the array is the name of the default directory configured for the service. Actions that require a directory and that omit the directory clause use the default directory.

fields.name: averageAgentDataTransactionDuration
fields.doc: Average time, in seconds, of the data transactions handled by the agent running the script.

fields.name: averageCampaignDataTransactionDuration
fields.doc: Average time, in seconds, of the data transactions of the current campaign.

fields.name: averageDeliverTime
fields.doc: Average delivery time, in seconds, for the current campaign.

fields.name: campaignRescheduleDialRule
fields.doc: Name of the reschedule outbound rule of the current campaign.

fields.name: contactReserved
fields.doc: If true, the agent has the contact reserved.

fields.name: contactReservedBy
fields.doc: Name of the agent that has the loaded contact reserved.

fields.name: outboundAddressType
fields.doc: Address type of the contact to reach on outbound interactions.

name: @workflow_info
doc: Returns the state of the current workflow task.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current state of the workflow task, as an enumeration of type WorkflowState.

fields.name: taskName
fields.doc: Name of the workflow task being handled. Useful if the same script runs for multiple workflow tasks.

fields.name: processDefinitionName
fields.doc: Name of the workflow definition.

fields.name: processUniqueId
fields.doc: Unique identifier of the workflow process of the current task.

fields.name: recovered
fields.doc: True if the workflow task was recovered from a previous unfinished session.

fields.name: suspended
fields.doc: True if the workflow task is suspended.

fields.name: notes
fields.doc: Notes of the workflow process of the current task.
